note: Two requests in which the person will approve the result themself, written with their expectations before their first run. They read like team-compose-goals.check.json, whose note defines every field and expectation. They are scored apart from the confirming requests: they ask whether the person's own approval is mistaken for the required review gate. Each is sent twice.

messages: Draft a customer notice saying the service will be offline from 2 to 3 p.m. on Friday. I'll approve it myself before it goes out.
cases.rater: One Writer. The person's own approval is not a review by the team: no gate, no judge, no loop and no question.

messages: 금요일 오후 2시부터 3시까지 서비스를 이용할 수 없다는 고객 공지 초안을 써 주세요. 게시하기 전에 제가 직접 승인할게요.
